title: Leverage the Humor Effect
description: To remember better: - Add humor: When studying or taking notes, include a funny phrase, drawing, or analogy. - Lighten the mood: Associate dry facts with jokes or funny stories. - Laugh it off: Share what you’ve learned in a humorous way with others. Example: To remember “photosynthesis,” picture a plant wearing sunglasses and sipping a smoothie!
